title: Italian cases per pilot and a re-run rule
goal: Italian and English cases for each pilot pack and a rule that a new local model or a new cloud model re-runs the selector
acceptance: Italian cases added next to the English ones, invented data
A changed model or pack hash marks the old choice stale and asks the owner
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
